changelog: Bookings UI rebuilt into compact mobile cards with clear date, time, type and status hierarchy.
Public bottom navigation is forced into one clean 4-item row: Home, Bookings, Queue and Settings.
Admin bottom navigation remains one clean 5-item row.
Drea proof-of-payment button now uses the Messenger thread route instead of the broken Facebook username-style link.
Existing booking, queue, duplicate-name and match-history behavior is preserved.
